intro: Lesson 78: Geometry: angles, polygons and circle theorems. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: (a) O centre, angle OAB = 22° where A, B on the circle: find angle AOB and the angle at the circumference on the major arc [3] (b) Cyclic quadrilateral with angles 2x, 3x (opposite) : find x [2] (c) Tangents from T touch at A and B; angle ATB = 48°: find angle AOB [3] (d) Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 165°: number of sides [2] (e) Give the reason: angle in a semicircle [2]
questions.a: (a) 136°, 68° (b) 36 (c) 132° (d) 24 (e) the angle in a semicircle is 90°
questions.model: (a) OB = OA so OBA = 22, AOB = 136; circumference 68. (b) 5x = 180. (c) OAT = OBT = 90 (tangent ⊥ radius), 360 - 90 - 90 - 48 = 132. (d) exterior 15, 360 ÷ 15. (e) standard reason.

questions.q: ABCD is cyclic, AB = AD and angle BCD = 70°. Find angle ABD with reasons.
questions.a: BAD = 110° (opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral); ABD = (180 - 110) ÷ 2 = 35° (base angles of isosceles triangle ABD)

questions.q: The angle between a tangent and a chord is 64°. Find the angle in the alternate segment, giving the reason.
questions.model: The alternate segment theorem says the angle between the tangent and chord equals the angle in the alternate segment: 64°.

questions.q: Angle ACB = 41° and angle ADB is in the same segment. Find ADB.
questions.a: 41°: angles in the same segment are equal

questions.q: AB is a diameter and C is on the circle. Angle CAB = 27°. Find angle CBA.
Angle at the circumference 38°. Angle at the centre on the same arc?

questions.a: The angle at the third corner: it is always 90° (angle in a semicircle).
